people.name: Hezron
people.line: Son of Perez, grandson of Judah, ancestor of David.

people.name: Perez

translations.web: Judah became the father of Perez and Zerah by Tamar. Perez became the father of Hezron. Hezron became the father of Ram.
translations.bsb: Judah was the father of Perez and Zerah by Tamar, Perez the father of Hezron, and Hezron the father of Ram.
translations.kjv: And Judas begat Phares and Zara of Thamar; and Phares begat Esrom; and Esrom begat Aram;
translations.asv: and Judah begat Perez and Zerah of Tamar; and Perez begat Hezron; and Hezron begat Ram;
